calls.reason: Reuters establishes preliminary Anthropic talks and reports other firms approaching Meta. It does not establish their commercial viability or why Meta pursued Anthropic.
Reuters reports credit stress, while the Trepp sample reportedly has no delinquent loans. Neither establishes inevitable widespread collapse or rules out this undated forecast.

CBRE reports 1.4% vacancy and over 80% preleasing; SemiAnalysis reports booked future GPU capacity and rising rental prices. Together these clearly oppose the claim that incoming capacity massively exceeds demand.

CoreWeave names customers beyond the dominant buyers, but does not quantify their rental scale. Its backlog and Nebius's demand statements cannot establish whether substantial demand is broadly diversified.
Bloomberg documents financing stress, while American Compute identifies no public GPU-backed foreclosure. Neither establishes worldwide institutional losses or negligible collateral recoveries.
The 2030 deadline remains ahead. IEA documents improving energy efficiency per task, but that does not settle future facility operating costs or the viability of post-bubble businesses.
